firmwares.name: Gamut
firmwares.what: The guitar firmware, formerly called OpenPocket: a chain of 12 blocks in presets, with neural amp models (NAM), your own cabinet IRs, drives and effects, and a preset editor in the browser.
A stereo effects instrument: twenty effects in four modules that can be put in any order.
firmwares.note: PALETTE has passed its tests on a simulated pedal only. It has not run on a real pedal yet.
